source_text.ISS-0936: Issue ISS-0936 (local record docs/issues/ISS-0936.yaml, queue_ref Q-919, queue task 919, GH#2070; record may not yet be on this branch - PR #2071): scripts/uat_preflight.sh's qa-uat-env credential protocol (fetch_credential, ~line 290) expects the credential source's `token <user>` to print a line `Token: <jwt>`, but ai-dala-infra's qa-uat-env.sh `token <user>` prints a BARE JWT, so every actor login reports NO_PASSWORD. Fix: make fetch_credential accept a bare JWT line (three dot-separated base64url segments) as well as the `Token:` form. Add/adjust tests per project's existing preflight tests (none found under test/ -- TEST-DESIGNER decides a minimal in-repo test shape). Also update the script's header docs (qa-uat-env protocol paragraph) and scripts/README.md if they state the Token: form.

task.description: WF-03 Step 3c hard gate: review the diff of scripts/uat_preflight.sh (git diff origin/main -- scripts/uat_preflight.sh in the worktree). It handles bearer tokens from a credential source. Check against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md: token never printed/logged/written to file/argv (incl. --out JSON and error messages), bare-line acceptance cannot cause a hostname/noise/secret line to be sent as a bearer token to an unintended host, read-only behavior unchanged. Run the script yourself with a fake source to confirm no token leakage. Verdict PASS/FAIL with evidence. Modify only your handoff; no commit.

result.summary: Scope: in scope via INV-4 (script handles bearer tokens from a credential source). INV-1/2/3/5/9 NOT-APPLICABLE (no tenant-data path, response shaping, Lua/WASM, lookup-by-ID, or tenant-supplied outbound URL; token only goes to operator-supplied --base-url). INV-6 satisfied by this review. INV-7 NOT-APPLICABLE (no SQL). INV-8 PASS (parse_token_line is pure, total; fetch_credential keeps its try/except returning (None,None)). INV-4 PASS. Diff: new parse_token_line(): 'Token:' labelled branch unchanged in trust; bare branch requires full-line match of eyJ+3 base64url segments, len>=40, so hostnames, warnings, banners and password-like lines are rejected; first parsing line wins. Empirical run with fake qa-uat-env source (noise, hostname, password-like line, sentinel JWT, second JWT) against a local logging HTTP server: rc=1 only due to unrelated env GAPs; sentinel token count in stdout, stderr and --out JSON = 0; server saw the sentinel only as Authorization Bearer on GET requests to the configured base URL (me/modules, tasks/inbox, definitions/active, health without auth); second JWT never used; no token in argv (run_cred args are only ['token', user]); http() error path returns exception type name only; no new print/log of credential. All calls remain read-only GET. Not run: a noise-only source (code path trivially returns None -> NO_PASSWORD).
